originalControl.scope: Separate original 128 MiB control; not relabelled as fresh-reader evidence

reader.namespace: Each new no-network/non-root process mounts only immutable catalogs/objects, owner read-only recovery material/public trust, pinned executable and its empty output. No source/global index/runtime/operational keys. Hardlink immutable views share inodes and are not additional physical copies.

limits: 128 MiB is a bounded rehearsal, not the specified physical 100 GiB acceptance.

Changed-input full-byte oracle is a separately reported preparation read before capture counters/timing. All 24 later actual fresh-reader restores independently match the saved input hash and attributes.
Application-body caps and source/receiver timing are measured under shared CPU/HDD with deliberate proof refusal; no raw-wire saturation, universal PUT overlap or speedup guarantee.
Holder stores are 3 physically separate complete replicas on one test HDD; no separate host/controller failure-domain claim.
The selected previous-format executable remains a compatibility check, not a published release or real source/provider/production admission.
